name: @gusnips/locale
description: Where a language lives in a URL, and how it crosses to another origin. Path prefixes, the inverse split, and the query parameter a separate origin needs. Zero dependencies, no framework.
author: Gustavo Salomé

scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && bun run sync:docs
scripts.release:patch: bun pm version patch && bun publish --access public
scripts.release:minor: bun pm version minor && bun publish --access public
scripts.release:major: bun pm version major && bun publish --access public
